precepts.text: The saints are those that have made a covenant with the Most High by sacrifice.
precepts.point: The saints are defined by the scripture itself.

note.label: Psalm 16: The Portion of Mine Inheritance

precepts.why: David’s goodness extends “to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.” The saints are defined by the scripture itself: “Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.” The saints are those that have made a covenant with the Most High by sacrifice.

precepts.text: The Most High exalted the horn of his people, his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him.
precepts.point: The saints are defined by the scripture itself.

note.label: Psalm 16: The Portion of Mine Inheritance

precepts.why: “He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the Lord.” The Most High exalted the horn of his people, his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. So the saints that are in the earth, in whom is all David’s delight, are the children of Israel, those who made a covenant with him by sacrifice.

points: David asks the Most High to preserve him because he puts his trust in him, confessing that his goodness extends to the saints that are in the earth and to the excellent in whom is all his delight.

note.label: Psalm 16: The Portion of Mine Inheritance

points: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god. The pronoun "their" points back to his saints, warning that even his own people multiply sorrow when they chase after other gods.
David refuses to offer their drink offerings of blood or take up their names into his lips.

note.label: Psalm 16: The Portion of Mine Inheritance

points: The Lord is the portion of his inheritance and of his cup; the lines are fallen unto him in pleasant places and he has a goodly heritage.

note.label: Psalm 16: The Portion of Mine Inheritance

points: He blesses the Most High who gives him counsel, and his reins instruct him in the night season.

note.label: Psalm 16: The Portion of Mine Inheritance

points: He sets the Lord always before him; because the Most High is at his right hand he shall not be moved. This is not a bumper-sticker slogan; it is the true standing of a man who keeps the Most High before his face.

note.label: Psalm 16: The Portion of Mine Inheritance

points: His heart is glad and his flesh shall rest in hope, for the Most High will not leave his soul in hell nor suffer his Holy One to see corruption. This speaks of the resurrection on the third day.

note.label: Psalm 16: The Portion of Mine Inheritance

points: The Most High will show him the path of life; in his presence is fullness of joy, and at his right hand are pleasures forevermore.
